observations: Photo 0 shows a black Lumix mirrorless camera body with a lens attached, sitting on a blue cloth next to a charger.
Photo 1 shows the same camera from the back with the flip-out screen open displaying 'Please set the clock', plus a Lumix charger and one battery on the blue cloth.
The word 'LUMIX' is visible on the camera top plate in photo 0 and on the charger in photo 1.
A 'G' is visible on the top right of the camera body in photo 0, but 'G7' is not clearly readable.
Only one battery is visible in photo 1, though the seller claims two batteries.

claims.evidence: LUMIX brand is readable in photo 0 and photo 1, but the G7 model number is not clearly visible in either photo.
Photo 1 shows one charger and one battery; a second battery is not visible.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function correctly despite the screen message in photo 1.
risks.proof: Video of the camera booting, taking a photo, and reviewing the image on screen.

risks.risk: Batteries may not hold a charge.
risks.proof: Video of both batteries charging and powering the camera for an extended period.

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, scratches, or separation not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements under bright light.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be near the end of the camera's life.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, taking a photo, and reviewing it.
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements.
Screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu.
Video showing both batteries charging and powering the camera.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Lumix mirrorless camera with lens and accessories; even untested, it can be priced at its worst case.
